coding.note: Release report: code and pre-trained models are released. C1 ablation is coded YES because SHARED matches FLOPs and trainable parameters, differing only in having one shared module. Seeds coded MULTI because 5 fine-tuning seeds are averaged with no variance reported; pre-training is one run per setting. Compute coded N: 64 V100 GPUs are stated but not the duration. Tokens coded N: batch size and update steps are given but no token count. The rename is the authors calling adapter-style bottleneck layers 'modules' because they are trained jointly with the transformer weights. Its quote is the page 3 'inspired by the adapter architecture' sentence, because the clearer footnote is mixed with the other column. Several pages mix two columns, which limited quote choice. The data quote (9 words) and the C2 quote may fail the verbatim check.
